chemistry.notes: Estimated: same Kia pre-E-GMP 64 kWh pack and charger as the 2019-2022 Niro EV (Electrek: Soul EV 64 kWh pack "same as the Niro EV and Kona EV"; Wikipedia: Soul EV built on Kona Electric hardware). NCM 622.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same Kia pre-E-GMP 64 kWh pack and charger as the 2019-2022 Niro EV (Electrek: Soul EV 64 kWh pack "same as the Niro EV and Kona EV"; Wikipedia: Soul EV built on Kona Electric hardware). The 2019 Niro EV has no battery preconditioning (recorded on the Niro EV powertrain); unverified for Canadian Soul EVs, which may have a battery heater like the Canadian Kona.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same Kia pre-E-GMP 64 kWh pack and charger as the 2019-2022 Niro EV (Electrek: Soul EV 64 kWh pack "same as the Niro EV and Kona EV"; Wikipedia: Soul EV built on Kona Electric hardware). Niro EV 2019: 7.2 kW onboard charger.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same Kia pre-E-GMP 64 kWh pack and charger as the 2019-2022 Niro EV (Electrek: Soul EV 64 kWh pack "same as the Niro EV and Kona EV"; Wikipedia: Soul EV built on Kona Electric hardware). Tested Niro EV peaked at about 77 kW (Weekly Driver and EV Database also 77). Kia claimed about 100 kW for the first 50 % (Electrek, src-electrek-soul-ev-2020-epa), not reproduced on the sibling.
